title: Skabelon til hjerte med Cykel i cirkel
author: Jan Krümmel
associationEvidence: The source page links the bicycle photograph and a Cykel PDF in the same entry.
The first PDF page reproduces the green/white bicycle-in-circle photograph and labels the two sheets Grøn and Hvid.

construction.publishedRecipe: Woven sheets with additional enclosed cutout regions on the green sheet.
construction.instruction: Det med gult markerede skal skæres ud.
construction.instructionMeaning: The yellow-marked areas must be cut out.
construction.regularAlternativeFeasibility: Not established. This review does not prove that the visible design has no alternative regular-slit construction.

evaluationImplications: Keep the existing 22-photo reconstruction results and denominators unchanged. This is a post-hoc construction diagnosis, not a newly solved or silently excluded case.
Treat failure to reproduce the published bicycle as an unsupported-reference construction before attributing it to optimizer convergence alone.
The current partial material labels deliberately omit the fine bicycle strokes. Their source-paper score cannot certify motif recovery.
The photograph remains useful for body/background learning; future graph supervision must explicitly distinguish regular slits from additional cutouts.
The user previously allowed irregular constructions to be excluded from regular-solver goals. No new irregular-pattern support is added.
